column1: # The lines a carried file does not carry verbatim, one per line.
# `tools/check-carried.py` pins the Kept and C++ classes to the reference's text, body byte
# for byte; the default stays byte identity, and this table is the only way a line may differ.
# Its subject is *this program's outward identity*: the Haiku bundle signature is the name the
# OS registers the running program under, and the reference's value names the reference product
# <path>\t<line>\t<target line>\t<reason>.  `line` is the target file's own line number, so the
# reference line it replaces is `removed_lines + line - 1` from `carried-files.tsv`; the check
# reads the target line and the reason is what makes the row a reading rather than a hole.
